subject: English
passage:
While researching a topic, a student has taken the following notes:
• Hospitals traditionally use large MRI machines, which require dedicated rooms and specialized infrastructure.
• Traditional MRI machines can't be used in emergency situations or remote locations due to their size and setup requirements.
• These machines are also extremely expensive, costing millions of dollars and requiring extensive maintenance.
• Portable MRI devices, which cost under $100,000, can be transported to any location and set up within minutes.
• Portable MRI devices have been proposed as an alternative to traditional MRI machines.
prompt: The student wants to explain an advantage of portable MRI devices. Which choice most effectively uses relevant information from the notes to accomplish this goal?

choices.A: Portable MRI devices, which cost under $100,000, can be used in emergency situations and remote locations where traditional MRI machines are impractical.
choices.B: Despite being expensive, traditional MRI machines can provide high-quality medical imaging in hospitals.
choices.C: Hospitals currently use traditional MRI machines, but portable MRI devices have been proposed as an alternative.
choices.D: Though they are different sizes, both portable MRI devices and traditional MRI machines can be used for medical imaging.

explanation:
Choice A is the best answer. The sentence explains an advantage of portable MRI devices, noting that because they cost under $100,000, they can be used in emergency situations and remote locations where traditional MRI machines are impractical.

Why B is incorrect:

Choice B is incorrect. The sentence indicates that traditional MRI machines can provide quality imaging despite their cost; it doesn't explain an advantage of portable MRI devices.
